title: Equilibrium Gibbs Bifurcations of Bardeen-AdS Black Holes at Fixed Pressure
summary: In the direct horizon convention, the fixed-pressure Gibbs curve of the four-dimensional Bardeen-AdS black hole passes through an intermediate sequence between the Reissner-Nordstrom-AdS swallow-tail class and the single-branch regime as the regularization scale is increased. The on-shell curve is classified by its turning points and self-intersections, followed by local heat-capacity filtering and construction of the lower Gibbs envelope over stable branches.
